headline: Crypto Market Structure Brief: 23 Nov 2026
summary: Ethereum holds the top TVL position at $36.4 billion, followed by Base at $5.1 billion and Solana at $4.7 billion. USDT leads stablecoins with $174.6 billion circulating while several peg alerts remain active. DEX volumes are led by Aero Slipstream and Uniswap variants, with Tether generating the highest fees. Multiple security incidents occurred in the prior 14 days, primarily involving bridges and infrastructure.
